description: Playfrog prepares browser games for publishing from ChatGPT. It accepts static HTML5 and JavaScript files and stores an unpublished draft without creating a playable page or game-serving route. The watch page and game origin return 404, and the tool returns a claim link but no play URL or manage token. A draft can be revised only in the connector session that created it. No tool on this server publishes a game. A person must open the claim link, sign in to Playfrog, and finish publishing before Playfrog creates a public serving path. Unpublished drafts are deleted after seven days.

defaultPrompt: Prepare my HTML5 platformer as a Playfrog draft for me to review and publish.
I changed the physics. Update the draft.
